answers.core: It's a default application alert that's core to the Godot application, and seems unlikely to be able to be changed via the asset library.
answers.workaround: The issue is most applicable to users that run the .exe and still use a console. However, I think it'd be a decent change to add to the editor as well (even though execution stops completely)

title: Make Console Taskbar Icon flash/alert when a Script Error occurs
